variation: Kneeling ab wheel rollout within a neutral-spine range; return without collapsing the hips.
camera: Fixed near side three-quarter facing left, full athlete and wheel with room ahead.
equipment: One compact dual-tread ab wheel and thin dark kneeling pad.
beats: Kneel; grip the wheel under your shoulders.
Roll forward slowly with your core braced.
Stop before your lower back starts arching.
Keep ribs down and hips extended.
Use your abs to draw the wheel back.
Return with control; keep your brace.
